children: Luxfer Holdings is supplementing its merger proxy after shareholder lawsuits and demand letters challenged its disclosures, while keeping the transaction terms and meeting schedule unchanged.
Two lawsuits and shareholder demand letters allege that transaction proxy disclosures are deficient and seek corrective disclosures and other relief.
Luxfer Holdings denies the allegations and says it is supplementing the proxy to reduce the risk of transaction delays and litigation costs.
The supplemental disclosures do not change the consideration or the November 4, 2026 shareholder meetings.
The board continues to recommend that shareholders vote “FOR” each proposal related to the transaction.
